title: Materialize AX-derived provider-neutral Agent Workload Runtime without creating a parallel authority
decisions: Materialize Task, Workspace, Runner, network-envelope and lifecycle patterns as FA3-native provider-neutral contracts.
Preserve Temporal as sole global durable workflow lifecycle authority; the workload reconciler is task-local only.
Preserve UAF as the action execution boundary and Security Governance as authorization authority.
Preserve HRB as the sole host resource admission, placement, reservation and lease authority.
Preserve Model Router as sole model/provider/runtime routing authority and Central MCP Gateway as the tool boundary.
Treat Work Management work items and Agent Workload Tasks as distinct identities linked only by optional reference.
Separate PAUSE from durable APPLICATION, PROCESS and VM checkpoint semantics and forbid fabricated suspend capability.
Require fresh HRB admission on resume and forbid reactivation of an old lease.
Forbid secret material in workload specs and checkpoints; resume obtains fresh secret projections.
Materialize native and Podman runner records as current-host-pending reference implementations.
Materialize Google AX as optional disabled-by-default external provider pinned to an immutable upstream reference; its v1alpha1 API is not canonical FA3 IR.
Do not adopt AX Model or Gateway objects as FA3 routing, credential, MCP or network authorities.
Google AX provider remains PENDING_CURRENT_HOST_OR_CLUSTER until scope-bound production E2E evidence exists.
Materialize an upstream-schema-bound Google AX provider manifest compiler for the representable subset without promoting Google AX runtime.
Fail closed when pinned AX v1alpha1 cannot represent FA3 immutable Git commit semantics; never downgrade a commit to a floating branch.
Do not project FA3 Skill Fabric or Central MCP Gateway authority into AX native registry discovery fields.
Do not emit AX Model resources; FA3 Model Router remains the sole model/provider/runtime routing authority.
Keep AX debug guest services disabled in the provider compiler until a separate explicit UAF/Security approval projection exists.
Materialize the FA3 Google AX custom-runner execution-plan compiler so immutable Git commits are checked out and verified inside the runner without weakening AX schema or FA3 authority boundaries.
Custom-runner source materialization does not equal runner-image, cluster-apply or runtime promotion evidence.
